title: Blocked people
summary: Lists the people the user blocked, with unblock on each row. Opens from the blocked row of Privacidade.

people.description: From Client.ignoredUsers, sorted by name. Empty: bipe_privacy_blocked_none.

loading.description: true until the first list arrives.

appear.effect: Client.ignoredUsers, then Client.getProfile for each person (name and photo) and POST /v1/handles/resolve for the @. Client.subscribeToIgnoredUsers keeps the list current.

notes: The row value in Privacidade (settings-group privacy) is the count of blocked people, or bipe_privacy_blocked_none.
A profile that does not load shows the @ or the Matrix ID's localpart. The row stays, so the user can still unblock.
